description: Eclipse provides a family of numerical reservoir simulators. SLB describes black-oil, compositional, thermal and streamline calculations, alongside field-management and well-modelling features for production and injection scenarios. The provider is SLB. Coverage: Coverage follows the network or reservoir supplied by the user. Spatial detail and the simulated time horizon are model settings; there is no fixed observation period. Access: The provider page describes the software and supplies a contact route for access. No executable or example model was obtained. Licence and cost: This is commercial software. The page does not establish the applicable licence agreement or a complete price; access terms must be confirmed with the provider. Limitations: Published capabilities are provider claims. No model was run and numerical accuracy was not independently tested. For infrastructure simulation it supports field-development and operating-scenario comparisons, subject to the supplied geological and well models. Related resources: For comparison, model-geophires-x addresses geothermal project calculations. This is a topical catalogue link, not an asserted coupling.
